raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: liteparse
  version: "2.11.1"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/l/liteparse/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 7d5fba0e9070e83461f2d4e5bde8d97376d23773b5d6cd0df48f048eeee42759
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/run-llama/liteparse/ae1ae83f527b016d4f318ee27023381109702425/LICENSE
    sha256: c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4
    file_name: LICENSE
  - if: linux and x86_64
    then:
      - url: https://github.com/run-llama/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium%2F7897/pdfium-linux-x64.tgz
        sha256: af96f21fd8e9d53955013dad1d17b003d0120025e787b7ce611a685d57287594
        target_directory: pdfium-linux-x64
  - if: linux and aarch64
    then:
      - url: https://github.com/run-llama/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium%2F7897/pdfium-linux-arm64.tgz
        sha256: e81ec447dd00097eb2fc26cff88be53ea321495711a43af9ea7b50bebdea9226
        target_directory: pdfium-linux-arm64
  - if: osx and x86_64
    then:
      - url: https://github.com/run-llama/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium%2F7897/pdfium-mac-x64.tgz
        sha256: dea5c9cdedcbdc7b1ce72bf845a2ec8bda1b9d23a5eef0b61e2d217f8b4477d3
        target_directory: pdfium-mac-x64
  - if: osx and arm64
    then:
      - url: https://github.com/run-llama/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium%2F7897/pdfium-mac-arm64.tgz
        sha256: 954cd315ff7d7ec51824cc6289ad1b00a0981533cb9762a56fd122bcaa12cd27
        target_directory: pdfium-mac-arm64

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}
      version: ${{ version }}

    build:
      skip: win or ppc64le
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
        content:
          - if: linux and x86_64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-linux-x64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.so"
          - if: linux and aarch64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-linux-arm64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.so"
          - if: osx and x86_64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-mac-x64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.dylib"
          - if: osx and arm64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-mac-arm64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.dylib"
          - export PDFIUM_LIB_PATH="${PDFIUM_ROOT}/lib"
          - export PDFIUM_INCLUDE_PATH="${PDFIUM_ROOT}/include"
          - export OPENSSL_DIR="${BUILD_PREFIX}"
          - if: linux
            then:
              - ln -sf "${CXX}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/g++"
          - cargo fetch
          - cargo update --workspace --offline
          - cargo auditable install --locked --no-default-features --features tesseract --path crates/liteparse --root ${{ PREFIX }} --no-track
          - mkdir -p "${PREFIX}/lib"
          - cp "${PDFIUM_LIB_PATH}/${PDFIUM_DYLIB}" "${PREFIX}/lib/${PDFIUM_DYLIB}"
          - cp "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/LICENSE" PDFIUM-LICENSE
          - cp -R "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/licenses" pdfium-licenses
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - make
        - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - openssl
        - pkg-config

    tests:
      - script:
          - lit --help
          - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/libpdfium.dylib" || test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/libpdfium.so"
          - printf '%s\n' '%PDF-1.1' '1 0 obj << /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >> endobj' '2 0 obj << /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >> endobj' '3 0 obj << /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 200 200] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >> endobj' '4 0 obj << /Length 44 >> stream' 'BT /F1 12 
            Tf 72 120 Td (Hello LiteParse) Tj ET' 'endstream endobj' '5 0 obj << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >> endobj' 'xref' '0 6' '0000000000 65535 f ' '0000000009 00000 n ' '0000000060 00000 n ' '0000000117 00000 n ' '0000000251 00000 n ' '0000000345 00000 n ' 'trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 6 
            >>' 'startxref' '415' '%%EOF' > smoke.pdf
          - lit parse smoke.pdf
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - lit

    about:
      summary: Fast, lightweight document parsing CLI
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - THIRDPARTY.yml
        - PDFIUM-LICENSE
        - pdfium-licenses/*.txt
        - pdfium-licenses/*.md

  - package:
      name: python-${{ name }}
      version: ${{ version }}

    build:
      skip: win or ppc64le
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
        content:
          - if: linux and x86_64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-linux-x64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.so"
          - if: linux and aarch64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-linux-arm64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.so"
          - if: osx and x86_64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-mac-x64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.dylib"
          - if: osx and arm64
            then:
              - export PDFIUM_ROOT="${SRC_DIR}/pdfium-mac-arm64"
              - export PDFIUM_DYLIB="libpdfium.dylib"
          - export PDFIUM_LIB_PATH="${PDFIUM_ROOT}/lib"
          - export PDFIUM_INCLUDE_PATH="${PDFIUM_ROOT}/include"
          - export OPENSSL_DIR="${BUILD_PREFIX}"
          - if: linux
            then:
              - ln -sf "${CXX}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/g++"
          - cp "${PDFIUM_LIB_PATH}/${PDFIUM_DYLIB}" "liteparse/${PDFIUM_DYLIB}"
          - cargo fetch
          - cargo update --workspace --offline
          - maturin build --release --locked --no-default-features --features tesseract --compatibility linux --interpreter ${{ PYTHON }} --out dist
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install dist/*.whl -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
          - rm -f "${PREFIX}/bin/lit"
          - cp "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/LICENSE" PDFIUM-LICENSE
          - cp -R "${PDFIUM_ROOT}/licenses" pdfium-licenses
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
            - maturin
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - make
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - openssl
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - python
        - maturin
        - pip
      run:
        - python

    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - liteparse
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - liteparse

    about:
      summary: Python bindings for LiteParse document parsing
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - THIRDPARTY.yml
        - PDFIUM-LICENSE
        - pdfium-licenses/*.txt
        - pdfium-licenses/*.md

about:
  summary: Open-source document parsing with spatial text extraction and OCR processing
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/run-llama/liteparse
  repository: https://github.com/run-llama/liteparse

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - moritzwilksch

content: cargo auditable install --locked --no-default-features --features tesseract --path crates/liteparse --root ${{ PREFIX }} --no-track
